title: Page 68
transc:
Washington April 19th 1864
Geo D Sheldon 
Ft. Monroe
Harriet for Lieutenant pandora begs Vincent zebra pebble Sampson
boats & perfume tugs leave growl immediately for Appian
zodiac princess wise wicks from fool and baptism has
Chart erred feeble side wheel weaslers penny propel cars
plunder tugs plank wayworn bar geese lampoon can all
bar goose all to leave with despatch unity Tappan
can fleet France his chart heard weaslers and a
large number of schooners to send peru ballasted zebra will
chart her warrior some double decked weasel barges capacity postpone
publish Cattle & more weasels hers among weaslers already Chart
heard are George Leary Helen Getty Metamora Champion Matilda highland
light Richland & other names not yet reported unity I
have called for a list of names with capacity which
will be forwarded when received Zodiac all not already under
way will be ordered to Appian direct those first Chart
heard were ordered to assemble here yoke Me eggs Belcher
TT Eckert


Culpepper 8.40 P. M. April 19 / 64
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Betty Hope for Knave Appian Shelby Peck should be able
to hold Plymouth with the saint he has unity you
however will have to be the Judge of what is
best to do unity The moment you move from animal
all walnut saints weighing along the abacus Coast will be
with drawn & you can then bring away sir plus
whinny to waylay your tanning oyster yoke Jupiter Nancy Sweats
SH Beckwith
